messages.content: Write one SYNTHETIC diplomatic utterance, not a quotation or reconstruction. Preserve ALL required conditions, numbers, actor roles, channel and commitment strength. Use generic we/you, not actual country names. A historical source only supplies discourse context. Do not copy unsupported historical details. Return an utterance under 65 words in a direct private negotiating-room statement style.

{"source": "China hopes that the conflicting parties in South Sudan can earnestly enforce and stick to the ceasefire and cessation of violence, faithfully implement the peace agreement, and restore peace and stability to South Sudan at an early date.", "synthetic_required_meaning": "We will halt offensive military operations for 3 weeks IF you halt offensive military operations for 2 weeks. Our commitment depends on yours."}
